name: Fialkovye slyozy
source:
Semyon receives a strange letter. There is no sender, and no recipient either. Something terrifying and mysterious hides within these messages, something he will regret for a long time. Later on, he will look back on this with a smile, but as for what was behind them and what Lena had to go through to finally be happy, you will find out in this story.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2948476876]Steam[/url]]
translation:
谢苗收到一封奇怪的信。没有发件人，也没有收件人。这些信息中隐藏着一些可怕而神秘的东西，让他后悔很久。稍后，他会微笑着回想这一切，但至于他们背后发生了什么，莉娜又经历了什么才最终获得幸福，你会在这个故事中找到答案。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2948476876]Steam[/url]]
